title: InferBench: per-route/model/region quantile advisor & regression watchers
creator: Aishwarya Patel
description:
Objective: Add a lightweight, production-safe quantile advisory layer and continuous regression watchers that produce p95/p99 time series per route, model, and region and surface actionable regressions. This work bridges the load-testing output (tokens/sec synthetic feeds) and runtime telemetry so on-call and SRE can triage emergent tail-latency degradations quickly.

Motivation: Current dashboards surface raw percentiles but lack a canonical baseline and automated detectors tuned for per-endpoint shape changes (e.g., increased cold-cache misses, batching regressions, or kernel mismatch when a new model variant rolls out). We need an automated advisor that suggests expected baselines and a regression watcher that triggers alerts and creates annotated incidents with candidate causes.

Scope:
- Instrument InferBench load harness to emit normalized tokens/sec and synthetic request markers (synthetic:true) so we can segment synthetic from production traffic.
- Produce p95 and p99 rollups with two aggregation windows (5m, 1h) and a 24h adaptive baseline for each route/model/region tuple.
- Implement delta-quantile regression detector using EWMA on percentiles with MAD-based thresholds and optional significance testing to reduce noisy false positives.
- Build Grafana dashboards: heatmap of tokens/sec by region/model, time-series cards for p95/p99 per route, a ranked regression table, and a guided investigator panel showing recent deploys/PRs and KV-cache warmup curves.
- Add exporter hook that writes quantile deltas and anomaly scores to the metrics lake for downstream alerting and ML training (format: metric, route, model, region, quantile, window, value, baseline, delta, score).

Technical approach:
- Metric ingestion: extend agent-side reporter to tag requests with route & model, add region label; ensure propagation through edge -> router -> runtime.
- Aggregation: streaming aggregator (Fluent/Beam style) computes p95/p99 using T-Digest per key; windows: sliding 5m step 1m, tumbling 1h. Baseline computed as EWMA of hourly medians over 24h.
- Regression detector: score = (current_quantile - baseline) / max(MAD, epsilon); alert when score > 6 for 5m or > 3 sustained over 1h. Allow temporary suppressions during known canaries.
- Dashboarding: Grafana panels with templating for route/model/region; include drilldowns that link to GH PRs and the deployment timeline.

Acceptance criteria (high-level):
- p95/p99 time series appear for 95% of active route/model/region combinations within 2 hours of rollout.
- The detector generates fewer than 2 false positives per week on staging signal for a 30-day run.
- Dashboards render heatmap and ranking table with <5s query latency for 30-day windows.
- On-call playbook updated and a runbook entry created with triage steps and common mitigations.

Rollout plan:
1) Instrumentation and schema changes in runtime (canary on dev region).
2) Deploy streaming aggregator in staging with synthetic traffic feeds for 2 weeks.
3) Validate detector thresholds against historical incidents and known-good baselines.
4) Gradual roll to prod regions: EU -> US -> APAC, enable alerting to infer-performance PD group after EU stable.

Notes: This ticket focuses on quantile advisory + detector + dashboards. Follow-ons for automated rollback, automated model variant fallback, and per-customer customized thresholds are separate tickets.
